sum: EZCORP, Inc. provides pawn services in the United States, Mexico, other Latin America, and the Caribbean. It operates through three segments: U.S. Pawn, Latin America Pawn, and SMG. The company sells pre-owned collateral forfeited from its pawn activities or merchandise purchased from customers. It also provides web-based applications, including EZ+ that allow customers to manage its pawn transactions, layaways, and loyalty rewards online. In addition, the company offers advance cash collateralized by tangible personal property, such as jewelry, consumer electronics, tools, sporting goods or musical instruments. It operates its pawn shops under the EZPAWN, Value Pawn & Jewelry, Empeño Fácil, Cash Apoyo Efectivo, GuatePrenda, MaxiEfectivo, La Familia Pawn, and Jewelry and CashWiz brands. EZCORP, Inc. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
ceo: Mr. Lachlan P. Given BBus (CEO & Director)
